title: Hawkeye 360 searching for 1.6 GHz at interesting places

tellings.quote: 1.6 GHz at interesting places I am certain has been looked at by Hawkeye 360

plain: A researcher named Bob Maguire tells Michels he is "certain" that Hawkeye 360, a company that picks up radio signals from orbit, has looked for signals at 1.6 GHz, a particular radio frequency, at what he calls "interesting places." He gives no source and says nothing more about which places or what was found. If he is right, a private company would have been quietly scanning for that one frequency at sites that matter to the subject.
